dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible on the lateral flank; these feature dark, irregular perimeters with high-contrast transitions to lighter grey interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, high-intensity light pixels and larger low-intensity dark blobs are distributed across the lateral and dorsal surfaces, particularly concentrated around the mid-body region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent 'O' shaped structures on the lateral flank form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated marbling pattern consisting of interconnected light grey lines creates a labyrinthine texture across the central and posterior dorsal regions.
